chunks: And from him, from several of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Abu Nasr, from Abd al-Karim, from al-Halabi, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about a man who divorced his wife while she was in her menstrual period, so he said: 'The divorce that is not according to the Sunnah is invalid.'
ai.seo_question: Is a divorce valid if a husband divorces his wife while she is menstruating?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies that a divorce pronounced during menstruation is invalid (*batil*) due to its deviation from the Prophetic Sunnah of *Talaq al-Sunnah*. This ruling underscores the Shia jurisprudential emphasis on the specific conditions of purity (*tuhr*) and the absence of intercourse as prerequisites for a valid divorce, distinguishing it from the Hanafi view of validity despite sin. The hadith serves as a foundational text for understanding the procedural integrity of marital dissolution in Shia fiqh.
